258.speaker: GHOST
258.text: Some of those people are still around.

259.speaker: GHOST
259.text: And the rest of the arcology?

260.speaker: GHOST
260.text: You have been out here alone?

262.speaker: GHOST
262.text: Report to the Vanguard in the Tower. The Vanguard is waiting.

263.speaker: GHOST
263.text: Speak to Ikora Rey in the Tower. The Vanguard is waiting.

264.speaker: GHOST
264.text: Speak to Zavala and Ikora in the Tower. The Vanguard is waiting.

265.speaker: GHOST
265.text: Speak to Zavala in the Tower. The Vanguard is waiting.

266.speaker: GHOST
266.text: Speak to Cayde-6 in the Tower. The Vanguard is waiting.

267.speaker: GHOST
267.text: Speak to Ikora Rey in the Tower. The Vanguard is waiting.

268.speaker: GHOST
268.text: Report to the Vanguard before the Leviathan. The Vanguard is waiting.

269.speaker: GHOST
where: Tower: after the last report of a stop

270.speaker: PETRA VENJ
270.text: Guardian. Keep your weapon low in the Landing. The Spider's crew are touchy, and I need them in a good mood.

271.speaker: PETRA VENJ
271.text: The Queen keeps accounts on this Shore, and I am the one who collects. The Barons who ran with Uldren are not the only ones who owe her.

272.speaker: PETRA VENJ
272.text: The Spider sells everyone everything, us included. Take this for your trouble. When I need a gun on the Shore, I will send for you.

273.speaker: PETRA VENJ
273.text: Guardian. The Strand is quiet, for now. The Mists have thinned, and what comes through them is not ours.

274.speaker: PETRA VENJ
274.text: Look up. The veil is torn, and the Taken walk the gardens as if they had always lived there. The Scorn are scavenging the ruins at Aphelion's Rest.

275.speaker: PETRA VENJ
275.text: The Queen is never worried. She is prepared. Hold the Blind Well, clear what you can, and tell her what you saw.

276.speaker: THE SPIDER
276.text: Ah, the Guardian. Come in, come in. Mind the guards, they bite.

277.speaker: THE SPIDER
277.text: Everything that crosses the Shore passes through my hands sooner or later. Ether, salvage, secrets. Even you, it seems.

278.speaker: THE SPIDER
278.text: Bring me something worth my while one day, and we shall talk business. Until then, enjoy my hospitality.

279.speaker: ERIS MORN
279.text: You walk like someone who has not been here long. Good. The ones who know the Moon walk quietly.

280.speaker: ERIS MORN
280.text: The Hive still sing in the dark below the Hellmouth. I listen, so that you do not have to.

281.speaker: ERIS MORN
281.text: It is a sensible reaction. Take this. It is what the dark gave me to share.

282.speaker: ANA BRAY
282.text: Careful where you point that. The Red Legion left more than wreckage out here, and the sand hides all of it.

283.speaker: ANA BRAY
283.text: I come out to the Buried City to remember what we built before the Collapse. The towers outlasted the people who raised them.

284.speaker: ANA BRAY
284.text: Some of us. Here, a little something for the road, Guardian.

285.speaker: SLOANE
285.text: You are the Guardian I asked for? Good. I do not have time for a speech, so here is the short version.

286.speaker: SLOANE
286.text: The rigs keep the lights on in the dome. The Hive moved into the Solarium and one of the tower wings, and they are still moving in.

287.speaker: SLOANE
287.text: Empty, and growing wild. Walk it carefully, Guardian. Take this, and clear me a path.

288.speaker: ASHER MIR
288.text: Assistant! You found the lab. Mind the wires, the Taken are fond of chewing them.

289.speaker: ASHER MIR
289.text: This is Terrabase Charon. The Traveler touched Io here, last of all, and the Light left marks on everything. The Vex noticed. The Red Legion noticed. Nobody asked me.

290.speaker: ASHER MIR
290.text: Never alone. I have my notes, and the Pyramidion humming at me all night. Take these, assistant, and go and listen to it for me.

291.speaker: CAYDE-6
291.text: There you are! Do not look at me. Look at the car. The very rusty car. Good.

292.speaker: CAYDE-6
292.text: Back when the Cosmodrome was a parking lot, I hid something here. A snack, or a weapon. Honestly, I forget which.

293.speaker: CAYDE-6
293.text: Rude. Take this for the trouble, and if anyone asks, we never met. Rule two!
